title: model-right-sizer calibration ledger entry
description: One row of recommended-vs-actual right-sizing evidence, appended by the `model-right-sizer-calibrate` skill to ~/.claude/skills/model-right-sizer-learned/ledger.jsonl (one JSON object per line). A row is meant to describe a TASK SHAPE, never a task, so that a learning recorded in one repo is safe and useful to read in every other one. WHAT THIS SCHEMA ACTUALLY ENFORCES, precisely: `additionalProperties: false` at every level rejects unknown KEYS, the closed `stage_kind` enum removes the main place a task could be named, and `lesson` is length-capped. WHAT IT DOES NOT ENFORCE: `lesson`, `recommended.model`, and `actual.model` accept arbitrary strings, so identifying text placed inside them is still schema-valid. Schema validation is NOT content sanitization. The controls that cover free text are the `model-right-sizer-calibrate` redaction check on append and the `model-right-sizer-verify` INTEGRITY pass, which reads the prose; neither is enforceable here, so do not treat a passing validation as proof a row is repo-agnostic.

id.description: Monotonic row id, e.g. cal-0001. Cite this id when a learning moves a pick.

ts.description: Date only (YYYY-MM-DD). Deliberately not a timestamp — a wall-clock time correlates a row to a session, which is a fingerprint.

stage_kind.description: The shape of the work, from a closed vocabulary. The closed enum IS the redaction lever: there is no way to describe WHICH review or WHOSE refactor, only what kind of stage it was.

loop_class.description: Agentic loop length under the model — the dominant axis for down-pin safety, per the agent's latency-inversion rule.

signals.description: The three 0-100 scores the blueprint assigned this stage.

model.description: Model id as published on the provider's sheet, e.g. claude-sonnet-5.

budget_tokens.description: The explicit thinking/token ceiling the blueprint set (the BudgetThinker layer).

confidence.description: Pass A's stated confidence % in this primary pick.

actual.description: What actually ran. Unknown numeric fields are omitted, never guessed.

quality.description: held = cleared the bar first try · missed = wrong output that was caught · rework = needed further cycles to land.

rework_cycles.description: Human/agent correction cycles spent. This is the cost-of-error term — the number that justifies sizing up.

adherence.description: Graded alongside outcome quality, not as an afterthought. A correct-but-3x-over-budget stage is still a right-sizing miss.

cost_delta_usd.description: actual spend minus recommended-tier spend, at list price. Negative means the override was cheaper than the recommendation.

pricing_freshness.description: Where the prices behind cost_delta_usd came from — the agent never asserts a price from memory without saying so.

verdict.description: What this row argues the next blueprint should do for this stage_kind.

lesson.description: One clause, task-shape vocabulary only. Hard cap is deliberate: prose long enough to narrate a specific incident is prose long enough to identify it.
